verdict.rationale: There's a dedicated public pricing docs page (referenced by docs-5, docs-6, docs-21, docs-9/16/22) covering per-credit tiers, search context cost tiers, and automatic tier advancement based on spend, all without requiring sales contact. However, no evidence snippet shows the actual dollar figures or a full per-model/per-request price table, and a community comment questions whether pricing has meaningfully changed or is well communicated. missing for 10: actual numeric price-per-request/per-credit figures in evidence, independent confirmation that pricing is clear/complete, and any pricing calculator or worked examples.
